title: Decision: Selecting Data Analytics Technology Stack
goals: enable data-driven decision making, improve reporting capabilities, establish scalable data infrastructure, and reduce time to insights

options.title: Full Snowflake Stack
options.description: Keep Snowflake as data warehouse, with dbt for transformations, Fivetran for ETL, and Preset for visualization

options.title: AWS Native Solution
options.description: Use Amazon Redshift for warehousing, AWS Glue for ETL, Amazon QuickSight for visualization, and native AWS tools for transformation

options.title: Open Source Stack
options.description: Deploy PostgreSQL/ClickHouse for storage, Airbyte for ETL, dbt for transformations, and Metabase for visualization

options.title: Modern Data Stack with BigQuery
options.description: Utilize BigQuery for warehousing, Fivetran for ETL, dbt for transformations, and Looker for visualization

criteria.title: Total Cost of Ownership
criteria.description: Expected costs including licenses, implementation, maintenance, and team training

criteria.title: Scalability
criteria.description: Ability to handle growing data volumes, concurrent users, and complex transformations

criteria.title: Ease of Implementation
criteria.description: Time and effort required to set up, configure, and deploy the complete stack

criteria.title: Team Expertise
criteria.description: Current team knowledge and learning curve for new technologies

criteria.title: Integration Capabilities
criteria.description: Ability to connect with existing data sources and downstream applications

criteria.title: Performance
criteria.description: Query speed, data refresh rates, and overall system responsiveness

criteria.title: Security Features
criteria.description: Built-in security controls, compliance capabilities, and data governance features

criteria.title: Vendor Lock-in Risk
criteria.description: Dependency on specific vendors and ease of future migrations

criteria.title: Community Support
criteria.description: Size of user community, available resources, and third-party tooling
